{{Quote|Greetings, young aspirants. I am called the Jailor, custodian of the Dawn Temple. It is my duty and my burden to oversee the care of those who have fallen to the lure of the dark side of the Force, and the return of their wounded spirits to the light.|The Jailor|<ref name="Lure" />}}
"'''The Jailor'''" was a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] who served as the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] for one of the three [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]s of [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]'s [[Dawn Temple]].<ref name="Lure" />
